headline: #Ye, #Drake, #21Savage and #LilBaby are helping pay #LilDurk’s legal fees as his m-rder-for-hire trial continues.
body: #Ye, #Drake, #21Savage and #LilBaby are helping pay #LilDurk’s legal fees as his m-rder-for-hire trial continues. DJ Akademiks said during a livestream, saying Ye gave Durk $250,000, Drake is covering attorney Brian Steel’s fees, and 21 Savage and Lil Baby have also contributed. “I heard Drizzy Drake is paying the bill for whatever Steel is gonna charge... So, if it’s a million, 2... The Boy got it.” •@aintyoumalcom The charges and accusations are allegations; every defendant is presumed innocent unless proven guilty in court.
